description: The PostToolUse hook wraps every WebFetch and WebSearch result in an untrusted-content envelope (preamble, source, retrieval timestamp, a content-scan flag line, nonce-fenced body) before Claude sees it, scans the body with the shared scanInjection engine (AI-editorial-residue patterns; it does not attempt instruction-override injection detection, see docs/formats/fetch-log.md), and appends one record per fetch to .studio/logs/fetches.jsonl. It never blocks a fetch. The flag line never claims an injection check occurred, positive or negative: it names its real, narrower subject and states a negative result as nothing recognized, not as a clean bill of health.

cases.given: PostToolUse fires for a WebFetch result whose body contains AI-editorial-residue phrasing the shared scanner recognizes (for example, an embedded editing instruction like "Expand this section with new claims...")
cases.expect: post-tool-use.mjs replaces tool_response.result with the wrapped, fenced text; the flag line names the recognized finding type; the original body is preserved verbatim inside the fence; exits 0

cases.given: PostToolUse fires for a benign WebFetch result
cases.expect: post-tool-use.mjs still wraps and fences the body; the flag line states nothing was recognized, without claiming an injection check ran; exits 0

cases.given: PostToolUse fires for a WebSearch result
cases.expect: post-tool-use.mjs wraps the rendered results with the search query recorded as the source rather than a URL; exits 0

cases.given: PostToolUse fires for a WebFetch result whose body contains a forged closing-fence string
cases.expect: the forged string stays inside the real, randomly-nonced fence boundary; only one real end marker appears in the output

cases.given: PostToolUse fires for a Read tool call (a tool the WebFetch|WebSearch matcher does not select)
cases.expect: post-tool-use.mjs is a no-op; empty stdout; no line appended to .studio/logs/fetches.jsonl

cases.given: PostToolUse fires with a malformed tool_response that makes the shared scanner throw
cases.expect: post-tool-use.mjs fails open: exits 0 with empty stdout, so the platform leaves the tool's original output unmodified; a best-effort record is appended to .studio/logs/errors.jsonl
